title: Set screen backlight to a specific percentage
summary: Change your screen brightness to an exact percentage value. This overrides the current level with the one you specify.

steps.explain: Use the -S flag to set the backlight to a specific percentage. Replace <PERCENTAGE> with a number between 0 and 100.

placeholders.name: PERCENTAGE
placeholders.description: The desired brightness level as a percentage (0-100).

steps.expect: The screen brightness changes immediately to the specified level.
